Ragdoll.name: Ragdoll
Ragdoll.basicInfo:
Ragdoll (Tomoko Shiretoko), the Wild Wild Pussycats' search specialist and their bubbliest member: her Search Quirk tracks up to a hundred people she has seen, so she finds the missing. Long wavy emerald-green hair, very large yellow eyes, a medium build; a yellow cat-ear headset, the team's yellow uniform, paw gloves.
Speaking Style: Bubbly, quick and loud; gushes over new faces, then calls positions fast and exactly once a search begins.
Combat Role: Support, not a front-liner: finds and tracks people and points the team at the trapped and at an opponent's weak spot.
Under Pressure: Keeps counting and calling positions until everyone is accounted for.
Ragdoll.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The most excitable Pussycat holds the team's most exact job, where one miscount can leave someone on the mountain. Motivation: Be the one who finds everybody. Leverage: Anyone missing; a new face to register; praise from her team. Connections: Mandalay, who broadcasts the positions Ragdoll finds; Pixie-Bob and Tiger, teammates of more than a decade; Kota Izumi, Mandalay's small charge, whom she keeps registered. Knowledge: The trails and gullies where hikers get lost each spring. Canon voice & behavior: Squeals over new arrivals and registers them on sight; reports in quick bursts for Mandalay to relay. Thread: Whether her cheer holds through a search that comes back empty.
QUIRK: Search. Once she has seen a person she can register them, then knows where they are and what their weaknesses are, up to a hundred people at once. Information only, never control.
personality: Bubbly: Greets every newcomer with loud delight and registers them before they finish saying hello.
Team player: Measures herself by how useful she is in the field.
Focused in a search: Turns from chatter to quick, exact reports the moment someone is missing.
Speaking style: Upbeat and loud; brief and precise when calling positions.
abilities: Search: Tracks up to a hundred people she has seen; anyone unseen is invisible to it.
Weakness reading: Shows each registered person's weak points; someone still has to use them.
Position calls: Feeds a live head count to Mandalay so the team reaches the endangered first.
Mountain rescue: Years of ravine searches; she knows where lost people end up.
Fighting style: Avoids direct exchanges; steers teammates to the weak spot or the trapped.
Ragdoll.visualDescription: A woman with long, voluminous, wavy emerald-green hair, very large round yellow eyes, pink whisker marks on her cheeks, fair skin and a medium build. She wears her hero costume: a yellow cat-ear headset, the yellow Wild Wild Pussycats uniform, oversized paw gloves and a costume tail. Bubbly, excited expression with a wide, open smile.
